source.name: Inter.it, 'Inter and Nike unveil the new Third Kit for the 2026/27 season'
source.quote: In the same way that Home and Away kits did, the Third Kit 2026/27 will see the presence of BBVA, Inter’s Official Sleeve Partner, who will join front sponsor Betsson.sport and back sponsor U-Power.

source.name: Footy Headlines, 'Inter Milan Announces BBVA as New Sleeve Sponsor'
source.quote: The BBVA logo will appear on the sleeve of the men's and women's first-team kits starting in the 26-27 season

source.name: Inter.it, 'U-Power becomes Inter's new official Back Jersey Partner'
source.quote: Starting from the derby, the U-Power logo will appear on the back of the Club’s kit in a deal lasting until 2027

summary: Front: Betsson.sport. Sleeve: BBVA. Back: U-Power. The club lists no other sponsor placements on the match shirt.
